verdicts.reason: A breaks the hierarchy: the attribution 'MAYA R., VERIFIED BUYER' is the biggest text and sits above the quote. The quote itself is squeezed into a narrow column at one or two words per line, and it crowds the giant bottle. The CTA sits up top, before the message, and the circle has become a stray fragment in the corner. B reads cleanly from logo to quote mark to quote to bottle to CTA. Its flaws: the attribution is heavier than the quote it credits, there is dead space between the quote mark and the quote, the bottle is small, and the peach circle is orphaned in the bottom-right corner, cut off and no longer behind the bottle.
